ny-statewide-election-districts.area: New York State outside New York City
ny-statewide-election-districts.summary: Election districts are drawn for New York City only. Outside the city this layer does not answer.
ny-statewide-election-districts.why: The state does publish a statewide layer, and it is a year behind at least one county's own and too slow to open. The city's own source is current, so it is the one that ships.
ny-statewide-election-districts.wanted: A current statewide election-district layer, or a county's own published election districts for anywhere outside New York City.

nyc-amenity-phones.summary: Library cards carry no phone number.
nyc-amenity-phones.why: Neither of the two publishers this layer reads has a phone number in it — it's missing at the source, not undisplayed.
nyc-amenity-phones.wanted: A public-library dataset for New York — either the city's three systems or the state's — that includes branch phone numbers.

nyc-community-education-councils.summary: The Community Education Council card names your council and district but no members.
nyc-community-education-councils.why: Each council publishes its own members on its own site, and there is no single list covering all thirty-two, so this app has nothing it can read for every district.
nyc-community-education-councils.wanted: One list of Community Education Council members covering all thirty-two districts, or the thirty-two council sites named in one place so each can be read.

nyc-school-zone-details.summary: School-zone cards name the zoned school but carry no school address or grade range.
nyc-school-zone-details.why: The city's school zone data carries neither the school's address nor its grade range, so there is nothing to display.
nyc-school-zone-details.wanted: A DOE dataset joining zone to school address and grade span by DBN, refreshed each school year.
